Nickel reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid. The reaction is slower than the reaction of iron with dilute
hydrochloric acid.
Strontium reacts with cold water more slowly than sodium reacts with cold water, but faster than
iron reacts with cold water.
Which statement correctly describes the order of reactivity?
A
Nickel is the most reactive and strontium is the least reactive.
B
Strontium is the most reactive and iron is the least reactive.
C
Iron is the most reactive and strontium is the least reactive.
D
Sodium is the most reactive and nickel is the least reactive.
